field.name: Feedback.inReplyTo
field.purpose: The id of the feedback entry this entry replies to. A stored line can never be rewritten, so a reply is its own line that names its parent; the thread is built at read. An entry with no inReplyTo is a thread root.

rationale: Feedback.feedback holds nested replies, but a stored line is immutable (k4), so a reply cannot be added to a parent that is already written. One optional field lets a reply be a separate immutable line; a3 (merge same-id lines) would weaken the integrity rule sc5 owns.
